claim: AWS CloudTrail Lake is no longer open to new customers starting on May 31, 2026. AWS recommends that CloudTrail Lake customers migrate their CloudTrail Lake log data to Amazon CloudWatch; for existing customers CloudTrail continues to be available, but CloudTrail Lake only receives critical bug fixes and security updates.

values.display: migrate your AWS CloudTrail Lake logs data
only receive critical bug fixes and security updates

qualifiers.condition: Existing customers can continue to use CloudTrail Lake; new customers cannot sign up from May 31, 2026.

evidence.quote: We recommend that you migrate your AWS CloudTrail Lake logs data to Amazon CloudWatch.
AWS CloudTrail continues to be available for existing customers, but CloudTrail Lake will only receive critical bug fixes and security updates.
AWS CloudTrail Lake will no longer be open to new customers starting on May 31, 2026. For capabilities similar to CloudTrail Lake, explore CloudWatch.
Existing customers can continue to use the service as normal.
